title: Smiling Toddler with Basket on Porch, 1939 California B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
ADE PROOF
APR 21 1939

Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: A charming candid snapshot taken in Fullerton, California, capturing a cheerful toddler standing on a concrete front porch. The young child smiles brightly while grasping a small woven wicker basket, possibly related to Easter festivities given the late April 1939 photofinishing date. The child is dressed in distinctive floral-print trousers, dark shoes, and a dark jacket or cardigan accented with white piping. A white-painted clapboard exterior, screen door, wooden garden trellis, and potted flowering plant frame the wholesome scene of American domestic childhood on the eve of World War II.
